description:
From the fz-66j root-cause investigation (2026-07-15, per-commit per-counter attribution on enum_list_allocations). THE WASTE: a statically SINGLE-TARGET protocol dispatch (Enum.reduce reducer bridge + user fn) regressed at k22.20 (2c407c16d) from fully-direct dispatch (golden: ZERO closure_call_lowered/callable_boundary events) to the generic indirect boxed-callable ABI -- every indirect call boxes its raw-int accumulator (box_scalar_for_any, ir_runtime.rs:310-322, unconditional ScalarBox, no small-int fast path) = +20 scalar_box native. k22.23 (8cb9b7a90) partially mitigated (+20->+5) but introduced BackendConstructionWrapper/construction_wrapper_for_fn (ir_interp/backend.rs; native mirror emit_capturing_closure/closure_capture_for_var_as in native_codegen/prim.rs) materializing a per-call heap struct for member selection AT A SITE WITH EXACTLY ONE CONCRETE MEMBER (+5 struct native, +1 interp). No polymorphism exists at these sites -- pure overhead. PARITY: native re-materializes per call in the loop; interp amortizes (1 extra struct total) -- architectural divergence, native is the over-allocating side.

THE CAPABILITY (designed, never built): fz-k22.24/25/26/27 were closed "folded into fz-k22.23 before implementation" -- their retained-discovery text specifies lazy native direct-boundary derivation from concrete FunctionRef/Lambda producers, separating direct-call authority from the published indirect callable inventory. Implement that: when a callable position has exactly one concrete resolved entry, dispatch DIRECT (no boxing, no wrapper); the indirect ABI is only for genuine multi-member/opaque flow. ACCEPTANCE: enum_list_allocations returns to its golden floor {5,80,9,288,0,0,3,48,0,0}/368 with run/interp/build PARITY, and enum_sort run/build scalar boxing returns to zero (fz-5vi) -- both fixtures green all legs; no other fixture counters move; goldens NOT reblessed upward. Baseline good commit for reference: 6ffdddae7 reproduces the golden exactly.

comments.text: SLICE-0 SCOPING COMPLETE (plan in the slice tickets .29.1-.4; full map in the agent report). KEY: k22.24/25 SUBSUMED by k22.23 (wrappers already publications-only; member sets exist). Remaining need is NARROWER than the folded k22.26/27 design: a consumption-side read of members.len()==1 && selection.is_none() at emit_callable_construction (native) + construction_callable_value (interp), gated by SSA-local construction-field resolution (branch-merged multi-producer falls through naturally -- no single construction identity). Shape-based select_callable_input_shape_for_demand explicitly UNSOUND for this (shape != producer) and out of scope. NON-GOALS ticketed separately if wanted: box_scalar_for_any small-int fast path; cross-callsite union direct dispatch. Baseline scoreboard recorded: ela 528/400/528 vs golden 368; enum_sort scalar {27,432} run/build, interp clean.

EPIC COURSE-CORRECTION: the slice-0 plan's attribution (BackendConstructionWrapper / indirect-call boxing) is provably stale for the two scoreboard fixtures at HEAD (zero wrappers published). Dated-tickets rule applies: fz-66j's bisect ran against the 975821da3-era tree; landings since (demand-floor widenings, k22.28 pins, sibling work) changed the terrain. NEXT: counter-level re-attribution AT the epic base -- instrument the allocation sites (HeapAllocKind provenance for struct + scalar_box) on both fixtures, diff against the known-good 6ffdddae7 values, name the allocating mechanism file:line. Slices 3/4 re-scoped after that. Slice 1's fact stands (cheap, audited, may serve the corrected design).

RE-ATTRIBUTION COMPLETE (evidence-grade, static arithmetic exact): the waste is the deliver_lanes CPS adapter family -- deliver_entry_continuation_for_source (native.rs:2363, invoked ~1504/2256) materializes the {:cont|:halt, acc} envelope as a real Tuple2 purely to match the shared multi-entry continuation convention, because the bridge closure's reducer.(entry, inner_acc) call goes INDIRECT: direct_closure_capture_lanes (native.rs:3611) returns None for a CAPTURED closure callee whose runtime value is opaque ValueRef, not Transport{Callable} (direct_callable_lanes bails, :3586). The tuple is made then immediately re-decomposed by reduce_step's dispatch prologue. ela struct accounting EXACT: HEAD 14 = reduce_step(5) + deliver_lanes(5) + 4 one-shots; golden 9 = same minus deliver_lanes. Native pays per-iteration (compiled continuation called 5x); interp amortizes via the shared entry table (+1) -- parity explanation architectural, to be confirmed in slice 3. enum_sort: same deliver_lanes family (18+ instances), scalar boxing via box_int_for_any/ValueRef coercion (fn_ctx.rs:163) -- high confidence, needs per-event confirmation before fix scope. CLASSIFICATION: (i) avoidable, same root as originally named (single-target dispatch gone indirect at k22.20/23), different manifestation than the stale wrapper attribution. NO REBLESS. Corrected slices re-scoped in .29.2/.3/.4.
